expected: Express.js is a web framework for Node.js.
Middleware is software that runs during request processing.
REST is an architectural style for networked applications.
An API is an interface that allows software systems to communicate.
JSON is a lightweight data format commonly used for exchanging structured data.
HTTP is a protocol used for communication between clients and servers on the web.
A database is a system for storing and managing data.
Caching stores frequently used data so it can be retrieved faster.
Authentication verifies the identity of a user or system.
Authorization determines what an authenticated user or system is allowed to access.
